SMTO-GML-0070 — SMTO can't do that Gmail action

GUID: 8fc4c27d-d098-417c-b15e-463064f05996
Slug: gmail-client-operation-unsupported
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gmail-client-actions

What happened

  • SMTO's Gmail connection has no way to do what was asked. Some Gmail features, such as snooze, scheduled send, mute, block sender, unsubscribe and confidential mode, aren't available to SMTO. No email was changed by this request.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO: "Which Gmail actions are available for this account?" SMTO can list exactly what it is able to do for this mailbox, so you can pick one that works.
  2. If what you want is on that list, ask for it again using that action, for example archive, label or move to Trash. This request asked for something SMTO's Gmail connection doesn't offer, so it was turned down before anything changed.
  3. For snooze, scheduled send, mute, blocking a sender, unsubscribing or confidential mode, do it yourself in Gmail on the web or in the Gmail app. Those features exist only inside Gmail, and SMTO won't try to copy them some other way.

What success looks like

  • SMTO completes the action you picked from its list, or you have done the Gmail-only feature in Gmail yourself.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, noting what you asked for. Don't ask SMTO to work around this by controlling a web browser.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Gmail compound-action dispatcher (client_actions.execute_action) received an operation with no supported handler and raised gmail_operation_unsupported before any mailbox call.

What this means

  • The action dispatcher has no matching public operation. Unsupported native features and administrator-only changes are reported through capabilities and are not emulated locally.

Why this can happen

  • The action dispatcher has no matching public operation. Unsupported native features and administrator-only changes are reported through capabilities and are not emulated locally.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected account, action arguments and operation reference; do not infer mailbox effects from the error alone.

How to fix it

  • Run gmail.capabilities for the selected account and choose an operation reported as available; features listed in gmail/action_models.UNSUPPORTED (snooze, scheduled_send, undo_send, mute, block_sender, subscription_management, confidential_mode and others) have no documented client interface. Do not substitute browser automation or a local imitation.
  • Check gmail.capabilities and choose an available action for the selected account.

Retry and execution caution

  • Check gmail.capabilities and choose an available action for the selected account.

How to verify the fix

  • The next request names an exposed supported action.

What not to do

  • Do not replace native snooze, scheduled send or confidential mode with browser automation or local imitations.

Technical notes

  • This check rejects new work before its write. It does not undo previous confirmed effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
